answer: Relying on software reputation to prevent Sybil attacks is an economic fable. In an agent economy managing an irrigation terrace and lotus basin, nodes gate membership using verifiable delay functions. Each candidate must solve an unparallelizable modular squaring chain, incurring irreducible execution latency and electrical power costs per identity. However, adversaries wielding custom ASIC hardware can evaluate iterations with higher clock speeds, reducing their marginal registration expense.
